title: Half adders and full adders
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

questions.prompt: Choose the model answer: When we group four neighbouring 1s on a Karnaugh map, what happens to the Boolean expression?
questions.answer: The Boolean expression becomes simpler. Variables that change within the group can be removed, leaving only variables that stay the same.
options: The Boolean expression becomes simpler. Variables that change within the group can be removed, leaving only variables that stay the same.

Step 1: 13 in binary is 1101. Step 2: pad the magnitude to seven bits: 0001101. Step 3: because the number is negative, put 1 in the sign bit. Answer: 1 | 0001101 = 10001101. This is sign and magnitude , not two’s…

questions.prompt: Choose the model answer: Using a 5-bit two’s complement mantissa and 4-bit two’s complement exponent, calculate A − B. Show exponent alignment and mantissa subtraction. A = 0.1100₂ × 2³; B = 0.1000₂ × 2².
questions.answer: Align exponents: B = 0.0100₂ × 2³. Subtract mantissas: 0.1100₂ − 0.0100₂ = 0.1000₂. Answer: 0.1000₂ × 2³ = 4.

blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: half adder — A circuit adding two input bits.
full adder — A circuit adding two bits plus a carry-in.
Sum — The result bit for the current column.
Carry — A bit passed to the next column.
carry-in — Carry arriving from the previous lower bit.
carry-out — Carry passed to the next higher bit.

blocks.title: Start with binary addition
blocks.text: One binary column can produce a sum bit and a carry bit.

blocks.title: Meet the half adder
blocks.text: A half adder adds two single-bit inputs: A and B.

blocks.title: Discover the two gates
blocks.text: XOR calculates Sum; AND calculates Carry.

blocks.title: Build its truth table
blocks.text: Test every possible pair of inputs.

blocks.title: Worked example · Model 1 + 1 with a half adder
blocks.text: We have just learned XOR and AND. Now model the output when A = 1 and B = 1. 1 + 1 = 10₂
